nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $T$ be a bounded linear operator on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$, let $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$, and let $\mu I$ be the image of $\mu$ under the algebra map from $\mathbb{K}$ to the bounded operators on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$, that is, $\mu$ times the identity. Then for every $x \in \ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$, $(\mu I - T)x = \mu x - Tx$.
nodes.title: Applying $\mu I - T$ on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z})$

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ and $N \in \mathbb{N}$, and write $\bar{\mu}$ for the complex conjugate of $\mu$. This is the function $f_{\mu,N} : \mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{K}$ with $f_{\mu,N}(n) = \bar{\mu}^{\,n}$ for $-N \le n \le N$ and $f_{\mu,N}(n) = 0$ otherwise (negative powers are inverses, with the convention $0^{n} = 0$ for $n < 0$).
nodes.title: Truncated approximate eigenfunction of the bilateral shift

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ and $N \in \mathbb{N}$, and write $\bar{\mu}$ for the complex conjugate of $\mu$. This is the vector $v_{\mu,N} \in \ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ whose $n$-th coordinate is the truncated approximate eigenfunction $f_{\mu,N}(n)$, that is, $\bar{\mu}^{\,n}$ for $-N \le n \le N$ and $0$ otherwise; it lies in $\ell^2$ because it has finite…
nodes.title: Truncated approximate eigenvector of the bilateral shift

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ be the Hilbert space of square-summable functions $\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{K}$. The bilateral backward shift is the bounded $\mathbb{K}$-linear operator $B$ on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ given by $(Bx)(n) = x(n + 1)$ for all $n \in \mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Bilateral backward shift operator

nodes.summary: For a function $x : \mathbb{Z} \to K$ with values in any set $K$, the bilateral backward shift of $x$ is the function $Bx : \mathbb{Z} \to K$ given by $(Bx)(n) = x(n + 1)$.
nodes.title: Bilateral backward shift of a sequence

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ be the space of square-summable functions $\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{K}$. The bilateral backward shift is the $\mathbb{K}$-linear map $B : \ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K}) \to \ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ given by $(Bx)(n) = x(n + 1)$ for all $n \in \mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Bilateral backward shift as a linear map

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ be the Hilbert space of square-summable functions $\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{K}$. The bilateral shift is the bounded $\mathbb{K}$-linear operator $S$ on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ given by $(Sx)(n) = x(n - 1)$ for all $n \in \mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Bilateral shift operator

nodes.summary: For a function $x : \mathbb{Z} \to K$ with values in any set $K$, the bilateral (forward) shift of $x$ is the function $Sx : \mathbb{Z} \to K$ given by $(Sx)(n) = x(n - 1)$.
nodes.title: Bilateral shift of a sequence

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ be the space of square-summable functions $\mathbb{Z} \to \mathbb{K}$. The bilateral shift is the $\mathbb{K}$-linear map $S : \ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K}) \to \ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ given by $(Sx)(n) = x(n - 1)$ for all $n \in \mathbb{Z}$.
nodes.title: Bilateral shift as a linear map

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $S$ be the bilateral shift on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$. Every $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ with $|\mu| = 1$ lies in the spectrum of $S$ in the algebra of bounded operators on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$, that is, $\mu I - S$ is not invertible there, where $\mu I$ is $\mu$ times the identity operator.
nodes.title: Every point of the unit circle lies in the spectrum of the bilateral shift

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. If $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ satisfies $|\mu| = 1$, then $\mu \bar{\mu} = 1$, where $\bar{\mu}$ is the complex conjugate of $\mu$.
nodes.title: A unit scalar times its conjugate is one

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, and write $\bar{\mu}$ for the complex conjugate of $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$. If $|\mu| = 1$, then for every integer $n$, $\mu \bar{\mu}^{\,n} = \bar{\mu}^{\,n-1}$.
nodes.title: Multiplying a power of the conjugate by a unit scalar

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ with $|\mu| = 1$, and let $N \in \mathbb{N}$. The truncated approximate eigenvector $v_{\mu,N} \in \ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$, whose $n$-th coordinate is $\bar{\mu}^{\,n}$ for $-N \le n \le N$ and $0$ otherwise ($\bar{\mu}$ the complex conjugate of $\mu$), satisfies $\|v_{\mu,N}\|^2 = 2N + 1$.
nodes.title: Norm of the truncated approximate eigenvector

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be the bilateral shift on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$, let $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ with $|\mu| = 1$, and let $N \in \mathbb{N}$. The truncated approximate eigenvector $v_{\mu,N}$ satisfies $\|(\mu I - S)v_{\mu,N}\|^2 = 2$, where $\mu I$ is $\mu$ times the identity operator.
nodes.title: Residual of the truncated approximate eigenvector

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$, let $S$ be the bilateral shift on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$, and let $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$, $N \in \mathbb{N}$ and $n \in \mathbb{Z}$. Let $f_{\mu,N}$ be the truncated approximate eigenfunction and $v_{\mu,N} \in \ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ the corresponding truncated approximate eigenvector. Then the $n$-th coordinate of $(\mu I - S)v_{\mu,N}$ is…
nodes.title: Coordinates of the residual of the truncated approximate eigenvector

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$ and let $B$ be the bilateral backward shift on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$. The spectrum of $B$ in the algebra of bounded operators on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$ is the unit circle $\{\mu \in \mathbb{K} : |\mu| = 1\}$.
nodes.title: Spectrum of the bilateral backward shift

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. The spectrum of the bilateral shift, as a bounded operator on $\ell^2(\mathbb{Z}, \mathbb{K})$, is the set of scalars $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ with $|\mu| = 1$; for $\mathbb{K} = \mathbb{C}$ this is the unit circle.
nodes.title: Spectrum of the bilateral shift

nodes.summary: Let $\mathbb{K}$ be $\mathbb{R}$ or $\mathbb{C}$. If $\mu \in \mathbb{K}$ satisfies $|\mu| = 1$, then its conjugate $\bar{\mu}$ is nonzero.
nodes.title: Conjugates of unimodular scalars are nonzero

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
